## Portrait-first widget showcases

Widget showcases open on the working app. A short install card follows the first interaction, and one source excerpt explains the result. The separate cover uses a close crop of the chart or map.

- Use `orientations: [vertical]` and `--orientation vertical` to build and check a portrait-only video.
- Use `context.layout: showcase` to keep the cover separate from the video opening.
- Use `code_wrap: false` to keep code lines whole. The renderer reports the file and line number if a line does not fit. Use `code_theme: dark` for a charcoal code card.

The Codex and Claude bundles include the updated widget starter.
